cues.en: Mike: In this video, I'm going to show you how to adapt the Z-score outlier identification method that you already know to the case of a multivariate dataset.
cues.zh: Mike：這部影片會示範，如何把你已經知道的 Z 分數離群值辨識方法，調整成適用於多變量資料集。

cues.en: And along the way, you will get a reminder of Euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 過程中也會複習歐幾里得距離。

cues.en: This term sounds really fancy, but it's probably something that you already know, even if you don't remember that it is called Euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 這個名稱聽起來很厲害，但你很可能早就知道這個概念，只是不記得它叫歐幾里得距離。

cues.en: So let's actually begin with Euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 我們就從歐幾里得距離開始。

cues.en: Here are two points.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個點。

cues.en: Imagine these are just two locations, two coordinates on this monitor here.
cues.zh: 想像它們就是這台螢幕上的兩個位置、兩組座標。

cues.en: The question is, what is the distance between these points?
cues.zh: 問題是，這兩點之間的距離是多少？

cues.en: How far is it from point A to point B?
cues.zh: 從 A 點到 B 點有多遠？

cues.en: Do you remember that formula?
cues.zh: 還記得那個公式嗎？

cues.en: I'm sure you learned it in your high-school geometry course, you might've forgotten it, but I'm going to put up the formula here, and I think it will look familiar.
cues.zh: 我相信高中幾何課一定學過，也許已經忘了，但現在把公式放上來，應該會覺得眼熟。

cues.en: So the distance between point A and point B is obtained by subtracting their X coordinates, and then squaring that,
cues.zh: A 點和 B 點的距離，先由兩者的 X 座標相減，再平方，

cues.en: plus subtracting the Y coordinates, and squaring that, and then taking the square root of that whole sum here.
cues.zh: 加上 Y 座標相減後的平方，然後對這個總和開平方根。

cues.en: So the difference in the X coordinates, which is here, the difference in the Y coordinates, and each of those are squared and summed, and then we take the square root of that.
cues.zh: 也就是這裡的 X 座標差，以及 Y 座標差，各自平方後相加，再開平方根。

cues.en: So that is the distance between A and B.
cues.zh: 這就是 A 和 B 之間的距離。

cues.en: Now it turns out, this is a bit of an aside, but turns out that that is only the distance for Euclidean space.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這其實只是歐幾里得空間中的距離。

cues.en: There are other geometries, there's other ways of measuring space, that are non-Euclidean, and they have different distance measures, but we don't need to worry about that for now.
cues.zh: 還有其他幾何、其他衡量空間的方式，屬於非歐幾里得幾何，距離量法也不同，但目前不用擔心。

cues.en: So this is the distance computation between two points.
cues.zh: 這就是兩點之間的距離計算。

cues.en: Now this is for a two-dimensional space, so where points A and B are on a two-dimensional plane.
cues.zh: 這裡是二維空間，也就是 A、B 兩點位於二維平面。

cues.en: How would you compute Euclidean distance if we had data points in three dimensions?
cues.zh: 如果資料點有三個維度，該如何計算歐幾里得距離？

cues.en: So in a three-dimensional space.
cues.zh: 也就是在三維空間中。

cues.en: Well, it's actually pretty simple, it's just a small modification of this formula here.
cues.zh: 其實很簡單，只要稍微修改這個公式。

cues.en: All you do is add the difference along the Z dimension, or the third dimension.
cues.zh: 加上 Z 維度，也就是第三個維度上的差值即可。

cues.en: And in fact, the Euclidean distance formula generalizes to any number of dimensions, any arbitrary number of dimensions.
cues.zh: 事實上，歐幾里得距離公式可以推廣到任意數量的維度。

cues.en: So you can have two points in an 18-dimensional space, and I don't really know what that looks like, you can't really close your eyes
cues.zh: 所以可以有位於 18 維空間的兩個點，雖然我也不知道那看起來是什麼樣子，你無法閉上眼睛

cues.en: and visualize an 18-dimensional space, but we can still compute an exact Euclidean distance between two points in an 18-dimensional space.
cues.zh: 想像 18 維空間，但仍然可以精確計算其中兩點之間的歐幾里得距離。

cues.en: And the formula looks just like this, except instead of summing together three square distances, we have 18 squared distances.
cues.zh: 公式也像這樣，只是原本加總三個平方距離，改成加總 18 個平方距離。

cues.en: Okay, so that's just a bit of a review about Euclidean distance for two points in some space on some plane.
cues.zh: 好，這是對空間或平面中兩點之間歐幾里得距離的一點複習。

cues.en: And now we're going to think about that in terms of distance in a kind of more abstracted space.
cues.zh: 現在改從比較抽象的空間來思考距離。

cues.en: So this is going to be a data space.
cues.zh: 也就是資料空間。

cues.en: So let's imagine you're doing some survey or something, and you ask people to report, let's say, how much money they spend on cocktails per month,
cues.zh: 假設你在做調查，請大家回報每個月花多少錢喝調酒，

cues.en: that's variable X, and how much money they spend on glasses of wine per month, and that's variable Y.
cues.zh: 這是變數 X，以及每個月花多少錢喝葡萄酒，這是變數 Y。

cues.en: So we have two variables here, so this is actually a multivariate data space.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個變數，所以其實就是多變量資料空間。

cues.en: Sounds very fancy, sounds very complicated, but multivariate just means multiple variables.
cues.zh: 聽起來很高深、很複雜，但多變量只是表示多個變數。

cues.en: So here we have two variables, that's more than one, so it's multivariate.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個變數，超過一個，所以是多變量。

cues.en: And it's a space, so we can compute distance inside this space.
cues.zh: 而它是一個空間，因此可以計算其中的距離。

cues.en: So for example, we can take this point A and this point B, and remember, these aren't really traditional ways of thinking about two points on a plane,
cues.zh: 例如，可以取 A 點和 B 點；記住，這不是我們傳統想像的、面前桌面這種平面上的兩點，

cues.en: on your desk in front of you, these are two points in this data space, but we can still compute the distance, it's like a data distance, between these two points.
cues.zh: 而是資料空間中的兩點，但仍然可以計算距離，可以說是兩點之間的資料距離。

cues.en: The formula is exactly the same, just the conceptualization is a little bit different.
cues.zh: 公式完全相同，只是概念上的理解稍有不同。

cues.en: Okay, so I think that's enough background.
cues.zh: 好，背景說明應該夠了。

cues.en: The next step that we need to do is just think about the multivariate mean, and the multivariate mean of a dataset is just the mean on all dimensions.
cues.zh: 下一步，思考多變量平均值，而資料集的多變量平均值，就是所有維度上的平均值。

cues.en: So it might be somewhere around here.
cues.zh: 可能在這裡附近。

cues.en: So this is the average, so the X coordinate of the mean value is the average of all the X values, and the mean on the Y axis
cues.zh: 這就是平均值，平均值的 X 座標，是所有 X 值的平均；而 Y 軸上的平均值，

cues.en: is the average of all the Y values.
cues.zh: 則是所有 Y 值的平均。

cues.en: So the multivariate mean is simply the mean along each dimension, and then you put them all together to put a dot in a space somewhere.
cues.zh: 所以多變量平均值，就是沿每個維度分別取平均，再把它們組合起來，在空間某處放一個點。

cues.en: So now I'm calling this point B, this mean is called point B.
cues.zh: 現在我把這個點稱為 B 點，也就是把平均值稱為 B 點。

cues.en: So now we can actually compute, this is pretty trivial, we can compute the distance in this data space between every individual data point,
cues.zh: 現在就能計算，其實很簡單，計算資料空間中每個個別資料點，

cues.en: so each individual in our survey, and the average of all of the data points.
cues.zh: 也就是調查中的每個人，到所有資料點平均值的距離。

cues.en: Okay, now if I were to stop the video here, I think you could probably guess what the Z-score method for multivariate outliers is.
cues.zh: 如果現在停止影片，我想你應該能猜到，多變量離群值的 Z 分數方法是什麼。

cues.en: So if you would like, you can pause the video, and try to come up with this method, and guess what I'm going to tell you for the rest of this video.
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以暫停影片，試著想出這個方法，猜猜接下來我會說什麼。

cues.en: Okay, so here is the Z-score method for detecting outliers in multivariate data.
cues.zh: 好，這就是在多變量資料中偵測離群值的 Z 分數方法。

cues.en: So step one is to compute the multivariate data mean, and I'm imagining that somewhere around here.
cues.zh: 第一步，計算多變量資料平均值，我想像它在這裡附近。

cues.en: And then step two is to compute the distance from each individual data point to that mean.
cues.zh: 第二步，計算每個個別資料點到平均值的距離。

cues.en: So we get this distance, and this distance, this is a large distance here, these distances are all pretty similar to each other, and so on.
cues.zh: 所以會得到這個距離、這個距離，這個很大，而這些距離都很相近，依此類推。

cues.en: And then we convert the distances to Z-scores.
cues.zh: 然後把距離轉換成 Z 分數。

cues.en: So let's say, this is 40 data points, we have 40 distances, and those distances are actually in whatever kind of weird metric is a combination
cues.zh: 假設有 40 個資料點，就有 40 個距離，而這些距離實際上使用某種奇怪的量值，結合了

cues.en: between variable X and variable Y, so it's gonna be a little hard to interpret.
cues.zh: 變數 X 和變數 Y，所以會有點難解讀。

cues.en: So we convert those distances into Z-scores, and then you just apply the same threshold procedure that I showed you over the past several videos.
cues.zh: 因此，把距離轉成 Z 分數，再套用過去幾部影片展示的相同門檻程序。

cues.en: So the Z-score distances might look something like this.
cues.zh: 距離的 Z 分數可能像這樣。

cues.en: And just to be clear that we're interpreting this in the right way, because these are two two-dimensional plots, so let me make sure there's no confusion.
cues.zh: 為了確保解讀正確，因為這裡有兩張二維圖，我要確認不會造成混淆。

cues.en: This plot shows the multivariate data space, we have variable X and variable Y.
cues.zh: 這張圖顯示多變量資料空間，有變數 X 和變數 Y。

cues.en: Each one of these points has an index.
cues.zh: 每個點都有一個索引。

cues.en: This is data index one, data point two, data point three, data point four, and so on, up to all 40 data points,
cues.zh: 這是資料索引 1、資料點 2、資料點 3、資料點 4，依此類推，一直到全部 40 個點，

cues.en: and each point has a distance to the multivariate mean, which is this big circle over here.
cues.zh: 而每個點到多變量平均值，也就是這裡的大圓圈，都有一個距離。

cues.en: And then we take all those distances, and we Z-score them, Z-transform them, and that's what we're plotting over here.
cues.zh: 然後取所有距離，轉成 Z 分數，也就是 Z 轉換，再畫在這裡。

cues.en: So now I can say that this point here, this is data point four, I don't know, let's just pretend that's this point over here, data point four is relatively close to the mean,
cues.zh: 所以現在可以說，這個點是第 4 個資料點，我不知道，先假設它就是這裡這個點；第 4 個點相對接近平均值，

cues.en: so its Z distance is relatively small.
cues.zh: 因此它的 Z 距離相對小。

cues.en: Okay, so then we threshold and we pick some threshold, and we've already discussed that picking this threshold is a little bit subjective, it's sometimes hard to know exactly
cues.zh: 接著設定門檻。我們已經討論過，挑選門檻有點主觀，有時很難確定

cues.en: what's the right threshold to pick.
cues.zh: 到底該選哪個門檻才正確。

cues.en: So I just picked three here, that ended up knocking out this guy and not this guy.
cues.zh: 這裡直接選 3，結果排除了這個點，卻沒有排除這個。

cues.en: And you can see, it's pretty debatable whether this is really an outlier and this isn't, so I don't wanna get into that discussion, because I'm focusing more on the method here,
cues.zh: 你可以看到，這個算離群值而另一個不算，其實很值得討論，但我不想深入，因為這裡重點是方法。

cues.en: but we would say this is considered an outlier based on our threshold, and this data point, this is data point 27, or whatever this is, that happens to correspond to this data point here.
cues.zh: 根據我們的門檻，這個會被視為離群值，而這個資料點，可能是第 27 個點，不管確切是哪個，剛好對應這裡的這個資料點。

cues.en: So this is what we consider an outlier in our multivariate space because it is far away from the mean relative to the distribution of distances
cues.zh: 所以，在多變量空間中把它視為離群值，因為相對於所有其他點的距離分布，

cues.en: of all the other points.
cues.zh: 它距離平均值很遠。

cues.en: Now what's really interesting about this method is that you can see that this data point here is actually not an outlier on dimension X.
cues.zh: 這個方法很有趣的一點是，可以看到這個點在 X 維度上其實不是離群值。

cues.en: So if you just project this down onto axis for variable X, it's not an outlier, it's not even the most extreme point, there are three data points that are more extreme,
cues.zh: 如果只把它投影到變數 X 的軸上，它不是離群值，甚至不是最極端的點，還有三個資料點更極端，

cues.en: and it's kind of extreme on variable Y, although this data point is even more extreme on dimension Y compared to this one.
cues.zh: 而在變數 Y 上，它算有點極端，不過這個資料點在 Y 維度上比它更極端。

cues.en: But this is an outlier in the multivariate space, not in any individual univariate space.
cues.zh: 但它是多變量空間中的離群值，而不是任何個別單變量空間中的離群值。

cues.en: The last thing I wanna mention in this video is that I'm illustrating this concept of multivariate outlier detection in two dimensions, in 2D spaces,
cues.zh: 這部影片最後想說的是，我使用兩個維度，也就是二維空間，來示範多變量離群值偵測的概念，

cues.en: so datasets where you've measured two things, but of course this procedure generalizes to any number of dimensions, it's just easiest to visualize in two dimensions.
cues.zh: 也就是測量兩件事的資料集，但這個程序當然可以推廣到任意數量的維度，只是二維最容易視覺化。

cues.en: All right, so in this video I introduced you to the multivariate outlier detection method, and I hope you see that it's really just a bit of an extension,
cues.zh: 好，這部影片介紹了多變量離群值偵測方法，希望你能看出，它其實只是稍微延伸，

cues.en: a little bit of a modification, of the Z-score method that you are now already quite familiar with.
cues.zh: 稍微修改了你現在已經相當熟悉的 Z 分數方法。
